name: Content scaling: quest money follows the quest's level in the realm's bands, with scaling on and off
contract: Requires CoAContentScaling.Enable=1 on a realm whose MaxPlayerLevel is below 70, so the TBC content is mapped
into the band below the cap, DestinyWeaver.Enable=1, DestinyWeaver.LevelScaling=1, CoA.QuestLevelScaling=1 and
Rate.RewardQuestMoney=1. Seek Out Ameer (10969) is a level-70 TBC quest that pays 4400 copper, a value of the
client's money table at level 70. Experience follows the level the quest has in the realm's bands, and so
must its money: authored TBC money on a compressed realm would pay level-70 amounts for level-60 play. Both
level-59 characters therefore receive less than 4400 copper - the one with scaling off what the quest's tier
pays at its level in the bands, the one with scaling on that value lifted to its own level less the
QuestMoneyKeepShare discount, never less than the value in the bands.

steps.label: Scaling off: the reward is the TBC quest's money in the realm's bands
Scaling on: lifted from the bands to the character, still below the authored value
